what: The multitrack run twelve-blocks-2 (2026-11-19, 04:31 to 05:45 UTC), pinned at its end. "run" lists every file the two tracks and the control room wrote in the run folder, with its sha256 (the staged material under inherited/ is this repository's own and is not listed; the control room's later judge548 folder is not part of the run). "copied" lists the files of this folder. The certificates are copied compressed (xz); the tracks' programs are pinned by hash and NOT copied: no code of either track is an input of the judge.
